工.meaning: Two flat planks joined by one stout post: a workbench seen from the side. Saws, glue and wood shavings everywhere. Whatever you build on it, a birdhouse or a boat, you make it by hand, and that's <kanji>craft</kanji>.
工.on: On the workbench you carve an ice cream <sound>co</sound>ne out of wood, sprinkles and all.

左.meaning: A <part>slash</part> crosses a <part>one</part>-plank arm reaching out over a <part>workbench</part>. A carpenter swings his hammer from that side only, and everyone else stands on the other side to be safe. He works with his <kanji>left</kanji> hand.
左.on: At lunch the carpenter eats one <sound>sar</sound>dine, holding it in his left hand.
左.kun: At the beach he hangs his shoe by the <sound>hee</sound>l, feeds a <sound>du</sound>ck and swims out to the <sound>ree</sound>f, always on the left.

穴.meaning: A <part>roof</part> covers a dark doorway whose sides spread like an <part>eight</part>. It's not a house, though. Something lives down there, and only its glowing eyes peek out. It's a burrow, a deep <kanji>hole</kanji>.
穴.on: You squirt <sound>ketch</sound>up into the hole to lure it out.
穴.kun: '<sound>Ah</sound>!' A paw shoots up and drags a whole <sound>na</sound>an down the hole.

空.meaning: A <part>workbench</part> sits right under a <part>hole</part> in the roof. Every night the tools vanish up through it, one by one. By morning there's nothing left but sky showing through. The bench is <kanji>empty</kanji>.
空.on: A pigeon flies down through the hole, finds nothing on the bench and lets out a long, sad '<sound>coo</sound>'.
空.kun: Through the hole you see the sky: a <sound>so</sound>fa floats past, and a cheerleader on it yells '<sound>Rah</sound>!'

目.meaning: A tall box with two bars across the inside. Tip your head to the side and it's an almond shape with lids top and bottom and a pupil in the middle. It blinks. It's watching you steal a cookie. It's an <kanji>eye</kanji>.
目.on: You tiptoe away, one foot in a soft <sound>moc</sound>casin, but the eye follows you.
目.kun: The eye rolls at your cookie stealing and sighs, '<sound>Meh</sound>.'

貝.meaning: A big <part>eye</part> peeks out between the two halves of a shell that sits on <part>eight</part>-shaped little feet. It shuffles across the sand, snaps shut when you come near and opens again when you leave. It's a <kanji>shellfish</kanji>.
貝.on: A kid on a <sound>bi</sound>ke rides along the beach, and the shellfish snaps shut.
貝.kun: The shellfish ties a string to its shell and flies it like a <sound>ki</sound>te over the beach.

側.meaning: The school has one <part>rule</part>, painted in big red letters by the door: coats go on the left wall only. Each kid hangs a jacket on a <part>coat hook</part> with their name above it, never on the right. Pick a wall and keep to your <kanji>side</kanji>.
側.on: Then someone hangs a smelly <sound>sock</sound> on a hook, and every kid switches sides.
側.kun: On the other side, a bulb of <sound>ga</sound>rlic makes them all cry '<sound>Wah</sound>!'
